blocking_findings.where: before staging each new batch and before push/retry
blocking_findings.finding: The remote tip is checked, but local HEAD can include unrelated commits. Push uses HEAD rather than the sealed pending commit. Resume may therefore publish an unplanned local HEAD.
blocking_findings.minimum_repair: When pending is null assert HEAD == state.expected_remote before staging; before push assert HEAD == pending.commit; push pending.commit:refs/heads/main.

nonblocking_notes.finding: A successful push followed by process failure before state save is safely rejected on resume because remote differs from expected_remote. It requires explicit reconciliation; current resume is not fully automatic/idempotent.

The index is verified before commit. For full isolation, disable repository hooks for commit or verify the resulting commit tree diff/blob OIDs after commit, because hooks may otherwise change the staged tree.

checks_supported: SHA256 bytes + Git blob SHA1/index comparison
Staged paths must exactly equal planned paths
No unrelated unstaged path is staged by broad discovery
